summary: Iteration 34 tested 4 items: (1) FIX1 House no. EN label on /portal (2) FIX2 feminine AvatarPicker avatars have no beards (3) FIX3 regression: Zoho Books card present in CMS Site settings → Engineering (4) NEW: per-admin AI translate rate limit backed by site_settings.ai_translate_limit_per_minute and CMS UI card. Backend pytest: 7/7 pass — direct DiceBear URL with facialHairProbability=0 returns 200 SVG; GET /api/settings echoes ai_translate_limit_per_minute (int); PUT /api/settings accepts value in [1..500], returns 422 for 0 and 9999; setting limit=3 and calling POST /api/admin/ai/translate 4 times returned 200/remaining=2, 200/remaining=1, 200/remaining=0, then 429 with detail 'AI translate rate limit (3/min) exceeded. Try again in ~1 minute.' Limit restored to 30 at end. Frontend Playwright: (a) On /portal with pb_lang=en the label reads 'House no.' and renders as a single line — postal_code label at x=1017, house_no label at x=1137 (w=48px), address label at x=1197 all on the same row y=536; label wraps the input (h=62 is label+input container, not text wrap). (b) Zoho Books card visible on Engineering tab (screenshot). (c) cms-ai-translate-limit-card visible with cms-ai-translate-limit-input=30; changing to 25 auto-saves on blur (persisted); entering 9999 clamps to 500; restored to 30 (verified via input value + backend GET /api/settings). (d) Users → Bewerken → Avatar tab → Vrouwelijk shows 19 DiceBear tiles, ALL 19 image srcs include 'facialHairProbability=0', visually no beard/mustache on any tile. (e) Regression: cms-title-translate + cms-desc-translate visible on Portfolio; fb-note-translate visible in Feedback → Notities modal.
critical_code_review_comments: Rate-limit persistence: the rolling 60s window appears to be tracked in-memory in the backend process. If backend restarts or scales horizontally, admins may bypass the cap. Consider tracking timestamps in MongoDB or Redis keyed by admin email for durability.

The 429 response body uses {'detail': '...'} while 200 responses expose top-level 'remaining' and 'limit'. Frontend consumers should also receive 'remaining' and 'reset_at' on 429 so the UI can display a countdown; today the client only knows the limit from the error text.

Field(ge=1, le=500) rejects 0/9999 with HTTP 422 which is correct, but the CMS input clamps client-side to 500 silently — no toast tells the admin what happened. Add a small helper text or toast when clamped.

detectLang() in AiTranslateButton is still naive keyword-based (carried from iter33) — same recommendation stands (either force target_lang and let LLM auto-detect, or replace with a library like franc-mini).
The DiceBear feminine avatar URL is quite long (~350 chars). Consider factoring the top= list into a constant to keep buildUrl readable.
seed_data_creation: None. Reused an existing feedback item (test · 8-8-2026) with 1 existing note 'hello test note' to verify the fb-note-translate button.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI translate rate limit is per-admin-email with a rolling 60-second window, tracked in-memory in the backend. If you run backend tests in parallel via pytest-xdist, calls will collide and race — always run this suite with `-o addopts=` (disable xdist) OR wait 60s between runs. To reset the window, either restart backend (sudo supervisorctl restart backend) or wait 60s. The CMS field is at /admin/settings → Engineering tab → cms-ai-translate-limit-card (data-testid=cms-ai-translate-limit-input). The default is 30 and the field auto-saves via PATCH-like PUT /api/settings on blur, clamped to 1..500 client-side and 422-rejected server-side. Avatar picker lives inside Users → Bewerken (Edit) modal → Avatar tab, not the Snelle weergave (Quick view) modal — the Quick view only shows profile info.
rca of the issue: No production bugs found in this iteration. Two testing pitfalls surfaced: (1) my initial FIX1 assertion assumed label text height <32px, but the <label> wraps the <input> so its bounding-box height of 62px is expected — visual inspection and label x-positioning on the same row confirmed the fix works. (2) The rate-limit test initially failed under pytest-xdist because two workers made translate calls that consumed slots in the 60s rolling window; running serially with `-o addopts=` fixed it and confirmed the 3/min limit is enforced correctly (200/200/200 with remaining 2/1/0 then 429 with 'AI translate rate limit (3/min) exceeded').
